reviews.text: Friendly, professional... I'm super happy in every way!

Noa and Nofre are so lucky to have found you!

I've been a client for two years now, and from day one, we've felt very well taken care of. Lidia and Andrea are so friendly, kind, and attentive, and you can see the love and dedication they have for all the animals.

I feel very at ease with them because, after many routine visits and a few scares, they've always been able to diagnose Noa and Nofre correctly and determine the best course of action.

It's so reassuring to know they're in such good hands. Thank you for taking such good care of them 💜

We received wonderful service at the Rovira Veterinary Clinic. They treated our kitten Copito wonderfully. They gave us an appointment right away, and the whole team is lovely, from the receptionist to the veterinarian. They explained everything in great detail, and their treatment of the animal was loving, gentle, and very professional. Plus, they sell pet food and supplies inside the clinic, which is super convenient. Highly recommended!

Amazing experience! We brought our cat for an annual check-up and vaccination, and everything went very well starting from booking the appointment to the visit itself. The vet was very gentle with our cat, did a thorough check and answered all our questions in detail and without rushing through them. Will definitely come back again.

I want to say first of all that I am making the assessment based on the experience I had with this clinic. At no time do I want to denounce or accuse them. It is only the explanation of my assessment.
Due to travel problems, I could not take my dog ​​to her usual veterinarian. They explained the dog's condition with high analytical results, BUN and creatine and explained that in 2020 she had been treated for Leishmania and her kidney had been affected, they were informed of the medication and that at that time she had an episode of vomiting. They visited her, gave me stomach protector, diet and probiotics. In the end, the vomiting began to normalize and they advised me that if she vomited again it would be better to have an abdominal ultrasound.
In mid-May she vomited again and when she urinated sometimes when she strained it came out a little stained. I spoke to them. I said I would take her to Vidavet and the person I spoke to told me it would be perfect because she had worked there and would talk to them.
There, on May 18th they do an echo where they say that there is a small lump where the urine comes out, otherwise it is fine. The analysis shows creatine of more than 2 and a bun of 104, serious. They tell me that at the Rovira Clinic they have a machine to check for cystitis. The person at Rovira does a test, says that she has cystitis, gives me antibiotics and to see how it goes, I will come back in a week. It hardly stains maybe sometimes but not much, I tell her and despite the serious indicators of the bun she gives her another stick for another week and that if she is not completely well they would do a test to see what bacteria it was and give the correct antibiotic. Two days later I call her and tell her that I am stopping giving her because she is not eating and she is not well. She tells me that if I want her to lower it and to put her on a diet. In two days the dog couldn't eat anything, even though I tried different homemade and canned foods. On June 7th, I took her from the emergency room to vidavet. With two weeks the bun value had risen to 263, the creatine to 7.3 and the phosphorus to 22.4. I took her home, desperate and knowing that I could no longer do anything for her. On June 10th she died.
I try to explain this not from the great pain that has accompanied me since that day but in an objective way because I consider that the management of her case with previous high kidney values ​​was not adequate. This is my assessment in the face of the facts that I have exposed. Totally real
Very good attention

Since adopting our greyhound, we've been with Andrea and Lidia, and we couldn't be happier. We've always received professional and friendly service.
The clinic is large, clean, and comfortable.
Every time we come with our greyhound, Minari, we feel right at home.

A very good experience. The staff were very friendly and helpful, and they treated our cats with great care during the check-up. They felt very comfortable at all times. They also gave us very helpful recommendations about their diet. A highly recommended veterinary clinic.
Super happy with Andrea and Lidia, they always treat us super well. My trusted veins!
A top-notch veterinary clinic. The service is impeccable, the professionals are empathetic, and above all, Dr. Lidia is incredibly caring with the animals. Thank you so much for your wonderful work!
Thank you so much for your review, Chloe! We're so happy you appreciate our work. We're here for you whenever Ivy 🐈 and Totoro 🐈 need us 💜 Hugs! …

You are our trusted veterinarian, and we are very grateful for your close attention, professionalism and dedication. Merlot could not be in better hands.
Thank you so much, girls!🤗💚🐶 …
I've been taking my dog ​​there for a while now, and they always try to help, plus they treat her with so much love!
Lidia and Andrea are spectacular! Five-star professionals.
Thank you so much, Viviana!

We're always grateful. With them, we know our Lucas is in the best hands.
Thank you.

Even so, they made time for my dog. I was extremely worried, but the treatment we received was exceptional: kind, friendly, and very professional. It's clear the whole team is experienced, and no matter who treats us, I always feel reassured knowing my dog ​​is in good hands.

Thank you so much, Ana!
Thank you so much, Elisenda!

The best veterinary clinic. The staff are incredibly professional and friendly. I've brought my dog ​​in several times and we've always left very happy. Keep up the great work, thank you so much!

They take the time to explain everything clearly and offer the best possible care. It's very reassuring to know our pets are in such good hands. Highly recommended!

Since she opened this clinic with her colleague Lidia, we haven't hesitated to continue going there. They are both incredibly professional and friendly, and they've always answered our questions with so much empathy and care, something we truly appreciate.

Both our dog Minari and we are thrilled with them, so we recommend them 100%! 🐾

Thank you so much for everything!!! 🥰

When you see your dog go in happy, you know it's the right place.
